facts.fact: Beltane 后两周，那个吻挥之不去；Maggie 对男子的细节（发色、衣着、气味）全记不起，只剩触感烙印——「他的回声遍布全身」。
facts.anchor: Nearly two weeks had gone by, and nothing could drive the kiss from Maggie’s mind.

facts.fact: Dahlia 在山楂树下午餐时提议用占卜符文（scrying spell）查男子身份；Maggie 反驳：scrying 需要目标的具体信息，而她们一无所知。
facts.anchor: The first thing Dahlia said to Maggie as she walked up to join her for lunch by the giant, ancient hawthorn tree that gave their college its name was, “What if we did a scrying spell?”

facts.fact: 面具挂在 Maggie 的后视镜上「嘲弄」她，花瓣已干成玻璃纸；但她确信重来一次仍会做同样选择——宁愿做梦也不让人进来。
facts.anchor: The mask taunted her from its new home, hanging from her car’s rearview mirror, its hawthorn petals drying to cellophane.

facts.fact: 音韵学课上法火灯摇晃、楼上巨响碎玻璃，硫磺混乙醚的「魔法出错」气味渗入教室——Ilex Hall 出事。
facts.anchor: The first sign that something was very wrong came when the flickering faefire lamps hanging from the ceiling began to swing on their dainty chains.

facts.fact: 楼梯门渗出淡紫淤泥：pall 出现——强大炼金反应失控的副产物，会在现实与彼界的织物上撕出裂口；Class 3 咒语在校园被严格禁止。
facts.anchor: “That is pall slime,” she said, breathless. “Stay behind me.”

facts.fact: Maggie 用粉笔画符文、诵 Diadhan 咒语封住渗泥的门，带 24 名学生改走南梯撤离，把学生交给 Dahlia 后自己逆行上三楼。
facts.anchor: When the rune was complete, she placed her palm on the chalk lines and said the Diadhan incantation to activate it—a simple phrase that invoked a temporary but impermeable seal.

facts.fact: 楼上开门的人正是「那位」Arthur Taliesin——首席炼金术师兼三楼实验室主任、已故名家 Rowena Taliesin 之子；三楼下午三点唯一有课的是他的 Materials Alchemy，pall 出自他实验室。
facts.anchor: Arthur Taliesin. The Arthur Taliesin. Lead alchemist and director of the labs on the third floor.

facts.fact: 两人在楼梯间争执封印方案：他抹掉她的符文、抢走她的粉笔画出更强封印，却始终不道谢；下楼时他叫出她的名字「别跟着我，Maggie」——她愣在原地，不知他认得自己。
facts.anchor: He didn’t wait for her response and jogged down the rest of the stairs, but Maggie was close on his heels. He stopped on the second-floor landing, his hand on the doorknob to the hall. “Don’t follow me, Maggie.”
